title: Aurekai Tool Definition
description: Schema for generated tool/function definitions emitted from registry/aurekai.capabilities.json — used for MCP tools, OpenAI function schemas, Anthropic tool definitions, Gemini function declarations, and agent-framework tool registrations.

generated_from.description: Source capability registry path, e.g. registry/aurekai.capabilities.json

name.description: Fully qualified tool name, e.g. akai.transcribe.audio

description.description: Human-readable tool description for LLM tool calling.

family.description: Capability family this tool belongs to.

cli_form.description: CLI invocation form, e.g. akai transcribe.audio --input FILE

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input parameters.

output_artifacts.description: Aurekai artifact filenames this tool may emit.

proof_emitting.description: Whether this tool emits a proof bundle on completion.

metering.description: Whether this tool records metering events.

annotations.description: MCP tool annotations (read-only, destructive, idempotent, etc.)
